text: The Fish Catcher is a unique weapon featured in the Fallout 4 add-on Far Harbor.
The Gauntlet is an unmarked location in Nuka-World, consisting of a multi-stage death trap built by the raiders controlling the park in 2287, beginning at the Nuka-station monorail landing.
The Paper Mirror is a side quest in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Anti-Materiel Rifle."
The Guarantee is a ranged weapon . It was available as a reward for completing the weekly challenge of "Crush, Kill, Destroy" in Survival mode from April 16 to April 22, 2019.
The Power Patrol is a fictional military organization created by Dynamite Animation Company for the pre-War television series Armor Ace and the Power Patrol.
The Jet Tones were a rock and roll band from Elyria, Ohio, active in the years 1958-1965. Their 1959 song "Henry" is featured in the Fallout TV series episode "The Past".
"Radiation Storm" The Think Tank, also known as the Dome, is a location in Big MT.
The Prydwen is an aircraft created and used by the Brotherhood of Steel and a location in the Commonwealth . It also makes an appearance .
The Scribe is an armor merchant that wanders the Commonwealth .
The Prototype is a side quest in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Prototype Gauss Rifle."
The Whitespring Station is a train station in Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

The Quick Fix is a melee weapon . It was available as a reward for completing the weekly challenge of "Survive" in Survival mode from April 30 to May 6, 2019. The weapon was then made available again from September 3 to September 10, 2019.
The Quantum Stag is a side quest in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Manwell Rifle Set."

The Subjugator is a fictional character created by the Dynamite Animation Company, serving as a major antagonist in the pre-War cartoon Armor Ace and the Power Patrol and its associated products and merchandise.
The Red Vipers are a group of fictional characters that were part of the pre-War television series Armor Ace and the Power Patrol and are featured in the March of Freedom board game.
The Varmint Rifle is a Fallout 4 Creation released on November 26, 2025. It must be downloaded via the Creations menu.
Tire armor, as the name suggests, is a piece of armor made from old tires.
The throwing star is a type of thrown weapon in Fallout Extreme.
A thrown explosive is a type of weapon that has existed in some shape or form in every Fallout game.
The Throatslicer is a unique weapon in the Fallout 4 add-on Nuka-World.
The Thunderbolt is a weapon in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Quake Thunderbolt."
Thru-hiker's is a third star armor and power armor legendary mod .
The torch is a melee weapon in Fallout: Brotherhood of Steel.
A tool kit is a miscellaneous item in Fallout Tactics and Van Buren. It is used to repair damaged vehicles, however, once a vehicle loses all of its Hit Points it is destroyed and cannot be repaired.
To-do: Power armor is a paper note . It was removed with the Steel Dawn update.
Toothed is a weapon mod for the shepherd's crook in the Fallout 76 update Wild Appalachia.
The Tone Death is a melee weapon . It is a variant of the death tambo.

This script is a trigger/activator script that manages the weapon confiscation and return system for The Tops in New Vegas in Fallout: New Vegas. It enforces the casino's no-weapons policy by stripping the player and their companions of all weapons when entering (via the greeter activation), storing them in hidden lockers, and automatically returning everything when the player exits the trigger volume.
The train tunnel is a metro tunnel added with the Fallout 3 add-on The Pitt and is located northwest of Fort Constantine.
The tri-beam laser rifle is a weapon in the Fallout 3 add-on Broken Steel.
The transport truck is a vehicle in Fallout, Fallout 2 and Fallout: Brotherhood of Steel.
The tribal raiding armor is a set of armor in Fallout: New Vegas.
The trail carbine scope is a weapon mod in Fallout: New Vegas.
The trail carbine steel forged receiver is a weapon mod which was cut from the final version of Fallout: New Vegas.
The trail carbine custom stock is a weapon mod which was cut from the final version of Fallout: New Vegas.
The train station is an unmarked location in the Mojave Wasteland .
Train Garun in GunWork was going to be a quest in Van Buren, the canceled Fallout 3 by Black Isle Studios. It was located in Blackfoot Village.
A train was a drivable vehicle available in the American southwest.
The tri-beam LR focus optics is a weapon mod added with the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Gun Runners' Arsenal.
The tri-beam LR HD caps is a weapon mod added with the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Gun Runners' Arsenal.
The tri-beam LR hi-cap terminal is a weapon mod added with the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Gun Runners' Arsenal.
The train car is an unmarked location in the Commonwealth in 2287.

"Train Train" is an original song created for Fallout 4, performed by Lynda Carter, who voices the character Magnolia. The song is played on Diamond City Radio and can be heard "Live" in The Third Rail bar in Goodneighbor. The song only plays on Diamond City Radio after the Sole Survivor first enters The Third Rail and hears Magnolia performing it. The lyrics suggest the song is about the day the bombs fell and subsequent events that parallel the history of the Institute, hinting that Magnolia is a synth.
Trapper armor is a piece of armor in the Fallout 4 add-on Far Harbor.

The triple-barrel handmade shotgun is a weapon in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Handmade Shotgun."
Treated leather is a material mod for leather armor in Fallout 76.
The trail fireworks is a weapon in the Fallout 76 update The Legendary Run.
The tranq gun is a weapon . It was released in the 1.16.0 update.
This script is a lightweight script controlling gas-based trap triggers in the game world. It reacts to either direct weapon impact or proximity triggers, depending on specific conditions.

The tribal helmet are four pieces of headwear for power armor in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Repurposed Power Armor Helmets."
The turbo plasma rifle is an energy weapon that appears in Fallout.
UAF armor was a light armor in the cancelled Fallout 3 project, Van Buren.
The truck stop is a stopping place for caravans in northern Texas. It is owned by Stella. Harold brings the player character here during the opening scene.
The truck wreckage is the location of a wrecked cargo truck that overturned on a hillside road in Point Lookout.
The turbo super sledge is a melee weapon in Fallout: Brotherhood of Steel.
The trooper helmet is a piece of headwear in Fallout: New Vegas.
The U.S.S. Interference was a submarine for the United States Navy.
The tuned plasma rifle is a weapon that appears in Fallout Shelter.
The tuned plasma pistol is a weapon that appears in Fallout Shelter.
The tuned alien blaster is a weapon that appears in Fallout Shelter.
The tuned laser rifle is a weapon that appears in Fallout Shelter.
The tuned Gatling laser is a weapon that appears in Fallout Shelter.
The Trusty Sidearm is a unique weapon in the Fallout: The Board Game expansion Fallout: New California.
The tweaked automatic receiver is a weapon mod for the 10mm pistol, assault rifle, combat rifle, combat shotgun and pipe gun .
The true medium barrel is a weapon mod for the pump action shotgun .
The true sawed-off barrel is a weapon mod for the double-barrel shotgun .
The true snubnose barrel is a weapon mod for the .44 pistol .
The tropical summer pant suit and tropical summer short suit are pieces of clothing .
Trumbull's power armor designs is a miscellaneous item in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Gunners vs. Minutemen."
The USS Wade was a United States Navy ship before the Great War.
The true automatic barrel is a weapon mod for the Enclave plasma gun, laser gun, plasma gun and ultracite laser gun .
The true flamer barrel is a weapon mod for the Enclave plasma gun and plasma gun .
The true sniper barrel is a weapon mod for the Enclave plasma gun, laser gun, plasma gun and ultracite laser gun .
The true stub barrel is a weapon mod for the 10mm pistol, 10mm submachine gun, pipe bolt-action, pipe gun and pipe revolver .
The true capacitor is a weapon mod for several energy weapons .
The tuned beta wave tuner is a weapon mod for the laser gun and ultracite laser gun .
The tweaked receiver is a weapon mod for the handmade rifle and radium rifle .
The true shielded barrel is a weapon mod for the Gauss rifle .
Turbo-Fert fertilizer is a weapon in the Fallout 76 update Wastelanders.
The true splitter is a weapon mod for the Enclave plasma gun and plasma gun .
The tulip sky blue pant suit is a piece of clothing in the Fallout 76 update Steel Dawn.
The Type 1861 "Springfield" rifle-musket was a weapon used before the Great War.
Two Shot is a legendary weapon effect in Fallout 4 and Fallout 76.
Troubleshooter's is a first star armor, power armor and weapon legendary mod .
Up to the Challenge is a challenge and an achievement/trophy in its add-on Gun Runners' Arsenal.
The US Army combat armor is a piece of armor in the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Lonesome Road.
The underwater suit is a piece of clothing in Fallout: Brotherhood of Steel 2.
The unyielding synth chest piece is a piece of armor in the Fallout 4 add-on Far Harbor.
Ultimatum is a unique weapon in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Tunnel Snakes Rule!"
Urban scout armor is an armor . It shares its base model with the Forest scout armor and covert scout armor, and matches the Urban Operative underarmor.

The Unstoppable Monster is a melee weapon . It is currently available as a plan from Daily Ops, as one of the possible daily rewards introduced in the Locked & Loaded update. It was formerly available as a reward for completing the weekly challenge of "Succumb to depravity" in Survival mode from June 4–10, 2019, introduced in the Wild Appalachia update. The challenge ran again from July 23–30, 2019.
The U.S. Chemical Corps is a division of the Enclave , developing a biochemical weapon to carry out global genocide.

Underarmor refers to a type of garment designed for wearing together with power armor of various types, meant to increase the comfort of the operator when wearing the outfit for extended amounts of time.
Ultra-light build is a miscellaneous armor mod in Fallout 76.
The umpire of the apocalypse outfit and umpire of the apocalypse helmet are an outfit set .
The ultracite arrows are a weapon mod for the bow and compound bow in the Fallout 76 update Wastelanders.
Union Station was a major train station located in Washington, D.C.
The Union outfit and matching Union helmet are an outfit set .
The Ultracite Terror Sword is a unique two-handed melee weapon .
Udder Madness is a side quest in the Fallout 4 Creations content "Brahmin Armor."
US Army armor is a piece of armor in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Revenge of the Van Graffs."
The Ultracite sword is a weapon that appears in Fallout Shelter. It was added with the 2.2.0 update as a reward for achieving level 2 in the Ultracite Fever season pass.
The Ultracite plasma rifle is a weapon that appears in Fallout Shelter. It was added with the 2.2.0 update as a reward for achieving level 7 in the Ultracite Fever season pass.
The Ultracite weapon workshop is a room that can be built with Fallout Shelter season 3 Ultracite Fever as part of the 2.2.x update.

Use Think Tank for Data was going to be a quest in Van Buren, the canceled Fallout 3 by Black Isle Studios. It is located in Boulder.
VATS matrix overlay is a mod available for power armor helmets . It requires Science! rank 2 to construct.
The V63 Zweihaender is a unique two-handed melee weapon, introduced with the Skyline Valley update.
V63-BERTHA is a unique ranged weapon in the Fallout 76 update Skyline Valley.
The V63 shock baton is a unique baton and one-handed melee weapon .

This script extends ObjectReference Const and triggers Bobby De Luca's Jet use animation upon the Sole Survivor entering its volume during the Vault 81 questline in Fallout 4. It advances the quest (V81_03) to stage 6 if stage 100 is complete but stages 400 and 6 are not.

This script manages post-combat events for a pit fighter in Fallout: New Vegas, specifically tied to a critter in the Thorn's fighting pit. It triggers on the death of a giant mantis, playing a crowd cheer sound, moving the surviving mantis to its starting position via VPitFighter02ToStart and removing both fighters from their respective factions. This script is obsolete and was superseded by VPitFighterDeath for broader use in the Thorn's arena.

This script is a trigger script (SCN) that seals the fighter access doors to the pit in The Thorn during Fallout: New Vegass quest Bleed Me Dry (VMS38). It activates when sufficient red creatures (CreaturesRedInThorn >= CreaturesRedNumber) enter the volume during a fight (FightersFight == 1), provided player/creature fights are active; it ignores the Courier if not fighting or creatures are, locks doors via Red Lucy activation, and executes only once per seal phase.

This script is a trigger script (SCN) that prompts Veronica Santangelo's one-time reaction to the Courier carrying the pulse gun during objective 20 of I Could Make You Care in Fallout: New Vegas. Upon the player entering the trigger volume (while in the same cell as Veronica and possessing the pulse gun), she delivers her dialogue topic, after which the trigger disables and deletes itself.
Valerie is the child of Vic the trader, working at Vault City's maintenance center in 2241. She is dressed in brown fatigues and metal armor.
Vault 101 security armor and Vault 101 security helmet are a suit of armor worn by the vault security officers.
Vampire's Edge is a unique Chinese officer's sword found in Fallout 3.
The Vault-Tec security armor and Vault-Tec security helmet are an armor set . The Vault 81 security armor, Covenant security armor, and security helmet are variants of this armor set.
The varmint rifle silencer is a weapon mod in Fallout: New Vegas.
The Van Graff combat armor is a piece of armor in Fallout: New Vegas.
The Van Graff laser rifle is a unique weapon in Fallout: New Vegas.
The varmint rifle extended mags is a weapon mod in Fallout: New Vegas.
The varmint rifle night scope is a weapon mod in Fallout: New Vegas.

{{Quotation|{{tooltip|Just follow the doctor, here. He'll show you where to go.|{Friendly} }}|sound=FO4 Vault 111 staff JustFollowTheDoctor.ogg}} Vault-Tec staff are staff members of Vault 111 in 2077.
Vault-Tec doctors are the medical staff of Vault 111 in 2077.
The Vault-Tec pant suit and Vault-Tec short suit are outfits .
The Vault-Tec distress signal is a radio signal in the Commonwealth in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Tesla Cannon". It consists of nothing more than a man's cryptic plea for help.
Valorous Alistair suit and matching hat are an outfit set purchased from the Atomic Shop .
Valley of the Gun was a pre-War western motion picture starring Cooper Howard in the role of a dual-wielding sheriff somewhere in the Wild West.

This script is a trigger script that manages a one-time "father walker" hallucination event (first in series) in Vault 106 in Fallout 3. When the Lone Wanderer first enters the trigger volume, it enables the single "father walker" NPC (vault106FatherWalker1B, a vision resembling the player's father from Vault 101 running toward the player) and applies the image space modifier vault106HallucinationISFX (psychedelic visual distortions from psychoactive gas: purple/blue tints, screen warping, vignette).

This script is a trigger script that manages a one-time "father walker" hallucination event (third in series) in Vault 106 in Fallout 3. When the Lone Wanderer first enters the trigger volume, it enables three "father walker" NPCs (v106FatherWalker3A/B/C, visions resembling the player's father from Vault 101 running toward the player) and applies the image space modifier vault106HallucinationISFX (psychedelic visual distortions from psychoactive gas: purple/blue tints, screen warping, vignette).

This script is a trigger script that manages door closure during the first "father walker" hallucination event in Vault 106 in Fallout 3. When any NPC (not the Lone Wanderer, via isActionRef player != 1) first enters the trigger volume (npcTriggered flag), it retrieves the linked door reference (attachedDoor via getLinkedRef) and closes it (.setOpenState 0), trapping the player with the activated vault106FatherWalker1B vision from the paired Vault106FatherWalk1SCRIPT to heighten tension in the gas-induced hallucination sequence.

This script is an armor script attached to the Vault 112 jumpsuit in Fallout 3. When equipped by the Lone Wanderer during stage 65 of Scientific Pursuits (MQ03), it sets the quest variable MQ03.SuitOn to 1, advances the quest to stage 70 (updating the journal to "Sit in the unoccupied Tranquility Lounger"), and forces package reevaluation (EVP) on the welcoming Robobrain (MQ03Robobrain2Ref) to enable interaction; on unequip, it resets MQ03.SuitOn to 0.

This script is an armor script attached to the cut/unused Makeshift gas mask (FormID , resembling the Raider blastmaster helmet) in Fallout 3. When equipped by the Lone Wanderer, it sets maskON to 1, enables the mask-on marker (Vault106GasMaskOnXMRK) for related checks (e.g., hallucination suppression in boss scripts), and removes the hallucination image space modifier (rimod vault106HallucinationISFX, clearing psychoactive gas visuals like purple tints/blurring); on unequip, if Vault106CBossPhaseOneMarker is enabled (indicating pre-boss fight in Vault 106's lowest level), it resets maskON to 0, reapplies the ISFX (ApplyIMageSpaceModifier), and disables the marker, but a scripting flaw causes the ISFX to persist permanently outside the vault.

This script is a magic effect script attached to the Victory rifle's critical hit effect in Fallout 3. On projectile impact during a critical hit (ScriptEffectStart), it retrieves a self-reference (myself via GetSelf, representing the rifle/projectile origin) and applies player.pushactoraway myself 5, ragdolling the Lone Wanderer's target away with moderate force (5 units) to simulate the rifle's unique 2-second knockdown effect on enemies.

Veronica Ann Belmont (born July 21, 1982) is an actress and podcaster who voiced Light Switch 01 and Light Switch 02, the Stealth suit Mk II and the unaltered holotape voice of Christine Royce in the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Old World Blues.

Dialogue for Dobbs, a man in a cryogenic chamber in the Sierra Army Depot. {{Transcript|text= {100}{}{A man dressed in standard military combat armor.} {101}{}{He looks healthy, but seems quite disoriented.} {102}{}{Oh, my head.} {103}{}{Who are you?} {104}{}{Ug!} {105}{}{I-I'm Dobbs, Private, First Class.} {106}{}{Can you tell me how you got here?} {107}{}{Bye.} {108}{}{I was in a battle. Yes, a battle. There was gunfire and explosions everywhere. People dying. I was scared but I had to keep on fighting. Then there was this blinding flash.} {109}{}{What happened next?} {110}{}{Bye,} {111}{}{The next thing I remember was seeing my body as if I was looking down at it from above. I heard the doctors say I was dead and then they threw my body onto a pile of other bodies.} {112}{}{And then what?} {113}{}{Bye.} {114}{}{Some men came by and took my body to a laboratory. I heard them say something about trying to regenerate my body by immersing it in something called Biomed Gel.} {115}{}{What else?} {116}{}{Bye.} {117}{}{And then I woke up here. I have to go! I have to get back to my unit.} {118}{}{Bye.} {200}{}{Where am I?} {201}{}{My head hurts.} {202}{}{Why am I covered in goo?} {300}{}{I have to rejoin my unit.} {301}{}{Oh no! The Yangtze-31 (揚子, yángzǐ; simply marked Yangtze in the game) is a submerged, barely functional Chinese submarine found in Fallout 4. When first discovered by the Sole Survivor in 2287, it is lodged in the shallow waters of Boston Harbor south of Boston Airport and northeast of the Four Leaf Fishpacking plant. The submarine is not marked on the map until the Sole Survivor swims out to it. Upon discovery, the quest Here There Be Monsters will automatically be started if not received already from Donny Kowalski near the Shamrock Taphouse.
The Yangtze terminal entries are entries found on various terminals in the Yangtze submarine in Fallout 4.

The Yangtze-class submarine was an achievement of Chinese technological development before the Great War, capable of penetrating enemy defense lines at sea and delivering quick and crippling nuclear strikes. It combined natural stealth of submarine vessels with Chinese stealth technology, making it a stealth submarine.
